scope: Observed Thai/US government curve nodes and index spots; assumed stochastic dynamics, FX and corporate credit
government_quotes: us_par_yields.json plus Thai dealer quotes embedded in thai_curve.json
interpolation: piecewise linear log discount factors; no extra smoothing
assumed_parameters: representative corporate intensity curves, CIR dynamics and 40% recovery
limits: Real-data initialized research test, not full market calibration, and not a physical-measure historical forecast/backtest.
